question: Which pop star just got sued by her own investors?
story: Selena Gomez is being sued by her own investors, and the lawsuit names her mother too. According to The Daily Beast, two investment groups tied to her mental health company have taken Wondermind Global to court. Selena, her mother Mandy Teefey, and former business partner Daniella Pierson are all named. The suits reportedly claim investors were deceived into putting in around one million dollars, because the company misrepresented its infrastructure, its leadership, and the resources it actually had. Those are their words. That money, they say, ended up funding the collapse. Reporting also says the company had fallen behind on paying vendors and employees on time. Here is the response. Mandy Teefey pushed back hard, reportedly calling it a few disgruntled employees with an ax to grind, spreading lies and distorting the truth. Wondermind launched in twenty twenty one as a place to talk honestly about mental health. Now it is a courtroom.
